name: double kneeling shin stretch
description: Kneeling and sitting back onto your heels to stretch the front of the shins and ankles.
instructions: Kneel on a mat with your feet pointing straight back and the tops of the feet on the floor.
Slowly sit back toward your heels until you feel the shins and ankles stretch.
Place your hands on the floor in front of you to control the pressure.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
